product_metadata.title: AOODA 65" Long Dress Garment Bags for Closet Storage, 4" Gusseted Clear Hanging Clothes Cover for Gowns, Coats (3 Packs)
features: 【4" Gussetes for 24pcs】Size: 24" * 65" * 4", Each hanging garment bags with 4" gusset, which are wider than standard bags, each pack roomy enough to hold 6-8 pcs women dress or 3pcs winter coat of normal thickness, can store about 18-24pcs long size clothes in total without getting squished at the bottom;

【65" Large for Long Dress】Set of 3 packs clear garment bags for hanging clothes, large capacity longer suit bags for closet storage perfect for length-to-ankle clothes such as long dresses, ball gowns, trench coats etc, without folding them, or anything shorter like suits, shirts, jackets and seasonal clothing；

【Visible & Lightweight Fabric】Well-made clear PVC front, help to know what is inside instantly, you can find the clothes conveniently and quickly without opening hanging garment bags. Dress bags for gowns long made of lightweight but sturdy fabric material, soft and silky, keep no smell;

【Durable Zipper】with full length center sturdy smooth zipper make clothes easy to take out and hang in. And have a small hole at the top of coat protector for closet keeping all your off-seasonal clothes fresh and wrinkle free;

【Multi-purpose】Clothes bags for storage hanging can be used for home storage and travel, ideal length for wedding dress,long gowns, tuxedo, sweaters, windbreaker, pants, dance costume, winter coat etc. Garment storage bag helped free-up some space and keeps your closet tidy and organized by color. When you don't need to use them, just fold the bags into small size.
